correctness.rationale: For each pair of adjacent retained letters, the number of skipped source positions is determined modulo q by their distinct labels. Under t<q all gaps are uniquely determined; at t=q the only ambiguity is a whole period gap q, forcing the sole output [P^(k-1)] and q consecutive-deletion orbits. Burnside on t-subsets under source-period rotation proves the exact divisor sum. Boundaries q,k>=2, t=0 and t=q are included. The independently implemented finite enumerator passed 75 parameter configurations and 255038 masks. The finite check is supplemental, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural first collision threshold of a circular deletion channel is solved exactly for all permutation powers, including the complete fiber classification, not just a numerical count. It distinguishes source-mask symmetry from actual output symmetry, supplies a closed form for every deletion budget through the first unavoidable phase wrap, and is pertinent to cyclic word reconstruction and deletion-ball enumeration. The range t<=q is structural (the first wrap of a q-letter source period), not an arbitrary parameter cutoff.
